column1: # Chinese glosses the maintainer chose for a word whose source wrote the same English gloss in both
# slots, where the borrowing rule (>= 5 uses, >= 90% agreeing) found too little evidence. Read by
# borrow_shift_blank_glosses.py; keyed by language directory, word (normalized) and English gloss.

column6: card tm~Bunun~at~then: "write 然後". NTU glosses at “then” in 394 other places with a Chinese gloss: 然後 321, 就 71, 救 1, 如何 1. The pair rule needs at least 5 uses and 90% agreement, so it did not borrow. My judgment of whether 然後 translates “then”: yes.
